# Case Nova

> Case Nova is a global interior design studio led by Vishakha Bhola, offering end-to-end residential and commercial interior design, online and onsite consultations, and fast-track design services across India and beyond.

Case Nova designs homes and commercial spaces around three principles: purpose, passion, and precision. The studio handles everything from first concept and space planning to material selection, execution support, and final handover.

## Founders
- Vishakha Bhola — Interior Design Head, Co-founder
- Suraj Shingate — Social Media Head, Co-founder

## Services
- Interior Design & Planning (residential and commercial)
- Online & Onsite Consultation
- Site & Execution Support
- Fast-Track Designing (signature service — expedited design delivery)
